Message Box ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Use a Promise to handle an alert, confirmation, or text prompt.

Alerts, confirmations, and input validation ​

Handle cancellation for each Promise. The prompt validates input with inputPattern and displays the returned value on success.

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="alert">
			提示
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="confirm">
			确认归档
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" :disabled="active" native-type="button" @click="prompt">
			输入名称
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxBasicDemo' });
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const result = ref('等待操作');
const active = ref(false);
const alert = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.alert('本地草稿已保存', '提示', { buttonSize: 'big' });
		result.value = '已阅读';
	} catch {
		result.value = '提示关闭';
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
const confirm = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('确认归档这条记录？', '归档确认', {
			distinguishCancelAndClose: true,
			buttonSize: 'small'
		});
		result.value = '已确认归档';
	} catch (action) {
		result.value = String(action);
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
const prompt = async () => {
	active.value = true;
	try {
		const data = await AsamMessageBox.prompt('请输入至少两个字的名称', '命名', {
			inputPattern: /^.{2,}$/,
			inputErrorMessage: '名称至少两个字',
			buttonSize: 'large'
		});
		result.value = data.value;
	} catch {
		result.value = '输入已取消';
	} finally {
		active.value = false;
	}
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	if (active.value) AsamMessageBox.close();
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}

.panel {
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg);

	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
}
</style>

}
</style>

Example: semantic-colors

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="colors">
		<AsamButton
			v-for="entry in types"
			:key="entry.value"
			type="default"
			:disabled="openedHere"
			@click="open(entry.value, entry.label)"
		>
			{{ entry.label }}（{{ entry.value || '空值' }}）
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const types = [
	{ value: '', label: '默认' },
	{ value: 'primary', label: '主要' },
	{ value: 'success', label: '成功' },
	{ value: 'info', label: '信息' },
	{ value: 'warning', label: '警告' },
	{ value: 'error', label: '错误' }
] satisfies { value: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>; label: string }[];
const result = shallowRef('等待操作');
const openedHere = shallowRef(false);

function closeOwned() {
	if (openedHere.value) AsamMessageBox.close();
}

async function open(type: NonNullable<AsamMessageBoxOptions['type']>, label: string) {
	openedHere.value = true;
	try {
		await AsamMessageBox.confirm('检查状态图标与内建动作按钮。', label, {
			type,
			confirmButtonText: '确认',
			cancelButtonText: '取消',
			confirmButtonType: type === 'error' ? 'danger' : type || 'primary',
			cancelButtonType: 'default'
		});
		result.value = '已确认';
	} catch {
		result.value = '已取消';
	} finally {
		openedHere.value = false;
	}
}

onBeforeUnmount(closeOwned);
</script>

<style scoped>
.colors {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}
</style>

Usage conventions ​

Use the general call or the alert, confirm, and prompt shortcuts. Each returns a Promise. See the usage conventions.

Host AppContext and shortcut overloads ​

All three shortcuts support (message, options?, appContext?) and (message, title, options?, appContext?). See overload details.

Configure the host application before mounting it.

js
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import App from './App.vue';

const app = createApp(App);
app.provide('asam-message-box-context', 'Content provided by this application');
app.use(AsamMessageBox);
app.mount('#app');

The complete TypeScript and JavaScript example switches between alert, confirm, prompt, and both overloads. Cancellation and unmount call the cancel action from this example's message, so its own Promise settles and other message boxes stay open.

Example: service-context

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<label>
			<span>服务类型</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="method" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="alert" :label="'alert'">alert</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="confirm" :label="'确认'">确认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="prompt" :label="'prompt'">prompt</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<label>
			<span>上下文</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="contextMode" :disabled="active">
				<AsamOption value="explicit" :label="'显式当前 AppContext'">
					显式当前 AppContext
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="installed" :label="'安装服务的默认上下文'">
					安装服务的默认上下文
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="null" :label="'显式 null'">显式 null</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(false)">
			使用 options 简写
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" :disabled="active" @click="open(true)">
			使用 title 重载
		</AsamButton>
	</div>
	<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }}</p>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamMessageBoxServiceContextDemo' });
import { defineComponent, getCurrentInstance, h, inject, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers, AsamMessageBoxOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const context = getCurrentInstance()?.appContext;
const method = ref<'alert' | 'confirm' | 'prompt'>('alert');
const contextMode = ref<'explicit' | 'installed' | 'null'>('explicit');
const active = ref(false);
const result = ref('等待操作');
let cancelOwned: (() => void) | undefined;
const Content = defineComponent({
	setup() {
		const label = inject<string>('asam-message-box-context', '未设置宿主 provide');
		return () => h('span', { 'data-context-label': '' }, label);
	}
});
const cancel = () => cancelOwned?.();
const open = async (withTitle: boolean) => {
	if (active.value) return;
	active.value = true;
	result.value = '等待确认';
	const message = ({ cancel }: AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers) => {
		cancelOwned = cancel;
		return h('div', [
			h(Content),
			h(
				AsamButton,
				{ type: 'default', nativeType: 'button', onClick: cancel },
				'取消本例弹层'
			)
		]);
	};
	const options: AsamMessageBoxOptions = {
		buttonSize: 'default',
		inputPlaceholder: '输入本次确认值',
		distinguishCancelAndClose: true
	};
	const appContext =
		contextMode.value === 'installed'
			? undefined
			: contextMode.value === 'null'
				? null
				: context;
	try {
		const value = withTitle
			? await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, '宿主上下文', options, appContext)
			: await AsamMessageBox[method.value](message, options, appContext);
		result.value =
			method.value === 'prompt' ? `confirmed: ${value.value}` : `resolved: ${value}`;
	} catch (action) {
		result.value = `rejected: ${String(action)}`;
	} finally {
		cancelOwned = undefined;
		active.value = false;
	}
};
onBeforeUnmount(cancel);
</script>
<style scoped>
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

</style>

Complete usage examples ​

These examples use the public ASAM UI entry points. Each includes a complete TypeScript and JavaScript SFC. See the API on this page for props, events, slots, and instance types. Close service instances that you create, and pass only trusted strings as HTML.

Alerts and their results ​

Example: ep2147-alert

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamMessage,
	AsamMessageBox,
	type AsamMessageBoxAction as Action,
	type AsamMessageHandler
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.alert('这是一条消息。', '标题', {
		// if you want to disable its autofocus
		// autofocus: false,
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		callback: (action: Action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: `操作结果：${action}`
				})
			);
		}
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

Confirm and cancel ​

Example: ep2147-confirm

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('此操作将永久删除文件，确定继续吗？', '警告', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		type: 'warning'
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: '删除成功'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消删除'
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

	AsamMessageBox.confirm('此操作将永久删除文件，确定继续吗？', '警告', {
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		type: 'warning'
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: '删除成功'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '已取消删除'
				})
			);
		});
};
const ownedAsamMessage = new Set();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

vue
<template>
	<div class="flex flex-wrap demo-gap">
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open">普通 VNode</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" class="!ml-0" @click="open1">动态属性</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessageBox, AsamSwitch } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h, ref } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		])
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};

const open1 = () => {
	const checked = ref<boolean | string | number>(false);
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		// Should pass a function if VNode contains dynamic props
		message: () =>
			h(AsamSwitch, {
				modelValue: checked.value,
				'onUpdate:modelValue': (val: boolean | string | number) => {
					checked.value = val;
				}
			})
	}).catch((action) => {
		if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
	});
};
</script>

	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
</style>

vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { h } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm(
		({ confirm, cancel, close }) => {
			return h('div', [
				h('p', { style: 'margin-bottom: 8px' }, '自定义按钮使用消息框操作处理器'),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						onClick: () => {
							confirm();
						}
					},
					() => '完成（resolve）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						onClick: () => {
							cancel();
						}
					},
					() => '拒绝（reject）'
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						text: true,
						onClick: () => {
							close();
						}
					},
					() => '关闭（close）'
				)
			]);
		},
		{
			title: '消息',
			showConfirmButton: false,
			showCancelButton: false,
			distinguishCancelAndClose: true
		}
	)
		.then((action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'success',
					message: `resolved: ${action}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((reason) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'error',
					message: `rejected: ${reason}`
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamMessage, AsamMessageBox, type AsamMessageHandler } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

import { h } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox({
		title: '消息',
		message: h('p', null, [
			h('span', null, '消息内容可以使用 '),
			h('i', { style: 'color: teal' }, 'VNode')
		]),
		showCancelButton: true,
		confirmButtonText: '确认',
		cancelButtonText: '取消',
		beforeClose: (action, instance, done) => {
			if (action === 'confirm') {
				instance.confirmButtonLoading = true;
				instance.confirmButtonText = '加载中……';
				setTimeout(() => {
					done();
					setTimeout(() => {
						instance.confirmButtonLoading = false;
					}, 300);
				}, 3000);
			} else {
				done();
			}
		}
	})
		.then((action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: `操作结果：${action}`
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((action) => {
			if (action !== 'cancel' && action !== 'close') throw action;
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

Distinguishing cancel from close ​

Example: ep2147-distinguishable-close-cancel

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="open">点击打开消息框</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamMessage,
	AsamMessageBox,
	type AsamMessageBoxAction as Action,
	type AsamMessageHandler
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';

const open = () => {
	AsamMessageBox.confirm('有未保存的修改，是否保存并继续？', '确认', {
		distinguishCancelAndClose: true,
		confirmButtonText: '保存',
		cancelButtonText: '放弃修改'
	})
		.then(() => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: '修改已保存，即将前往新页面。'
				})
			);
		})
		.catch((action: Action) => {
			trackAsamMessage(
				AsamMessage({
					type: 'info',
					message: action === 'cancel' ? '已放弃修改，即将前往新页面。' : '留在当前页面'
				})
			);
		});
};

const ownedAsamMessage = new Set<AsamMessageHandler>();
let mountedAsamMessage = true;
const trackAsamMessage = (handle: AsamMessageHandler) => {
	if (mountedAsamMessage) ownedAsamMessage.add(handle);
	else handle.close();
	return handle;
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	mountedAsamMessage = false;
	for (const handle of ownedAsamMessage) handle.close();
	ownedAsamMessage.clear();
});
</script>

Composition and lifecycle ​

Custom message buttons go through beforeClose. Handle the close and cancel actions separately if needed. See composition and lifecycle.

Additional usage and API details ​

Host AppContext and shortcut overloads ​

All three shortcuts support (message, options?, appContext?) and (message, title, options?, appContext?). To omit options, use (message, undefined, appContext). To omit the title and keep options, use (message, undefined, options, appContext). An explicit AppContext gives VNode content access to values provided by that app. Omit the context or pass undefined to use the default recorded by app.use(AsamMessageBox). Passing null skips that ASAM default and delegates to the underlying service, which can still use a default configured separately by the host.

More on options and events ​

Usage conventions ​

AsamMessageBox(options, appContext?) and the alert, confirm, and prompt shortcuts with (message, titleOrOptions?, optionsOrContext?, appContext?) return a Promise. Confirmation resolves the Promise. Canceling or closing rejects it, and distinguishCancelAndClose separates the two actions. A successful prompt returns value and action. Handle cancellation explicitly. Use beforeClose(action, instance, done) for an asynchronous guard and callback for callback mode. buttonSize accepts the four control sizes large, big, default, and small. Those sizes apply to the buttons. close dismisses message boxes globally. This example cleans up only when its own box is still open.

Composition and lifecycle ​

A message function can receive confirm, cancel, and close from AsamMessageBoxActionHandlers for buttons in its VNode. All three actions go through beforeClose and affect the same Promise. With distinguishCancelAndClose: true, cancellation rejects with cancel and closing rejects with close. confirm resolves with the confirmation result, and prompt returns action and value. Call done from beforeClose when asynchronous work finishes and the box can close. The box stays open until done runs. Use callback for callback mode and inputValidator, inputPattern, and inputErrorMessage for validation. The global close method can leave outstanding Promises unsettled. Use the specific cancel action to settle your own message box during cleanup when multiple examples or features can coexist.

The characters in this string are sequenced and concatenated in the following order: - "g" for global - "i" for ignoreCase - "m" for multiline - "u" for unicode - "y" for sticky If no flags are set, the value is the empty string.

  • inputPattern.sticky: boolean — Dependency declaration

    Returns a Boolean value indicating the state of the sticky flag (y) used with a regular expression. Default is false. Read-only.

  • inputPattern.unicode: boolean — Dependency declaration

    Returns a Boolean value indicating the state of the Unicode flag (u) used with a regular expression. Default is false. Read-only.
